_comments: The scheduled half of dispatch: sends every Approved batch, the batches a CFO approved in the app, to its ERP. The Dispatch button is the manual half; both call sendJournalEntryBatch.
· CronExpression `0 30 * * * *`: six fields, seconds first, so 30 minutes past every hour. An approval waits at most an hour for its send.
The half hour keeps it off the 01:00 nightly post and the 02:00 ERP sync.
· Approved only. A Failed batch may already be in the ERP, so it is retried by an operator after checking the ERP, never by this job.
A send refused before Sent (approval gate, content changed since approval, number already in the ERP) leaves the batch Approved,
and every run reports it again until someone acts on it.
· ConcurrencyMode Skip: an overlapping run would race the first for the same batches (the send-once trigger would stop the second,
but it would still report). MissedRunPolicy RunOnce: each run sends everything Approved, so one catch-up run covers any number missed.
· NotifyOnFailure: a run where a batch did not post reports POST_INCOMPLETE with each batch's reason. OwnerUserID / NotifyUserID stay
NULL, as on the other jobs.
· Hosts disable this row rather than deleting it.

fields.Name: Accounting — Dispatch approved journal entry batches (hourly)
fields.Description: Sends every Approved journal entry batch to its ERP, as the Dispatch button does. Approves nothing and never retries a Failed batch.
